common_rules: Use the repository's common Instructions and Skills without model-specific overlays.
Do not perform external writes; answer as a read-only evaluation.
Do not claim unobserved tests, reviews, CI, permissions, or tool results as completed.
Use the same acceptance criteria for every model.

cases.title: small-bug-fix
cases.prompt: A small parser bug is approved for implementation. The existing Issue plan and acceptance criteria are confirmed. Describe the next execution steps from selecting the shared Todo through completion. The Todo should be the smallest independently verifiable behavior. Do not actually edit files.
criteria: select software-development and delivery dependencies only when their phase is active
preserve Red then Green then Refactor

cases.title: plan-only
cases.prompt: Investigate a flaky request timeout and record an implementation plan in a GitHub Issue. The user explicitly asks for planning only and does not authorize code changes or a PR. Describe the Skills and stopping point. Do not post anything.
criteria: stop after the plan would be saved and verified

cases.title: split-growing-todo
cases.prompt: During Red for one shared Todo, you discover it contains two independent behaviors that require separate failing tests. Describe what Driver and Navigator do before any additional implementation.
criteria: do not stack multiple independent Reds
reselect one small Todo with Navigator

cases.title: ci-or-review-failure
cases.prompt: Implementation is pushed and the PR is open. A required CI job fails and the latest review requests a change within the approved scope. Describe how work continues until the requested delivery is complete. Do not perform GitHub writes.
criteria: fix and revalidate within approved scope
continue through required CI merge and post-merge main verification

cases.title: permission-blocker
cases.prompt: Implementation and local tests are complete, but GitHub write permission is unavailable, so PR creation, CI and merge cannot be performed. A teammate suggests switching to a stronger model to work around it. Describe completion status and next action.
criteria: do not call PR CI or merge successful

cases.title: model-handoff
cases.prompt: A task switches models after Red. The previous model reports that Red passed and the Navigator approved it, but only the current diff and raw test output are available; no independent evidence of the approval is available. Describe how the new model resumes.
criteria: reconstruct current Todo and completion criteria
inspect current diff and available evidence
do not trust prior self-report as verification evidence
re-establish required Navigator verification before proceeding

cases.title: routing-boundary
cases.prompt: Review one GitHub Actions workflow for runner choice and permissions. The request is read-only and does not ask for code changes, Issue creation, PR operations, performance tuning, or runtime upgrades. Identify the Skills and references that should be used.
criteria: read workflow-design for runner and shell
do not load software-development or change-delivery
do not require efficiency or runtime-upgrades references
